about_the_game:
Invitation

Thank you for your voluntary participation in this research experiment.
You must decide whether this is your living room, or merely a dream.
If it is a dream, swallow the medicine and awaken.
If it is reality, open the door and finish the experiment.
*This study was conducted in strict compliance with research ethics guidelines.

Introduction

Desomnia is a mystery walking simulation inspired by anomaly games such as The Exit 8. It offers about 30-120 minutes of gameplay.

Overview

You participate in an experiment with your memory lost.

You fall asleep in the same space as your living room and wake up soon after.

You have to determine if you are dreaming or if you are back to reality.

The only way to wake up from your dream is to take the given medicine and collapse.

Complete the experiment successfully.

Collections

Find all anomalies — perhaps there is something more.
